name: code-conventions
description: The engineering canon that holds in any language: a semantic question about code — a definition, its callers, its type, a file's diagnostics — goes to the language server through the LSP tool rather than to grep, a comment earns its place by saying what the code cannot, a restatement being deleted on sight, and a repository, pull request, merge request, or issue named in chat is a clickable link on whatever host serves it. It also covers bug reports on any tracker: what one carries, when it is filed, and where a vulnerability goes
